emma: Quick sync. Customer (Lynx) wants a compact remediation timeline they can show execs. They asked for "one-pager" format summarizing: key findings (count per severity), top 3 remediation actions, ETA windows, single POC. Can someone produce an executive-friendly PDF?

raj: I can supply the counts + top 3 technical fixes. currently: 2 critical (unpatched db), 7 high (auth misconfig + outdated libs), 18 medium/low (info leaks).

sarah: I'll draft the one-pager layout. Keep it high level: bullets + a small gantt for weeks 1-12. include assumptions and dependencies (e.g., maintenance windows).

mike: i'll export a redacted PDF and a small PNG gantt. plan: use report-redacted.html and wkhtmltopdf. example:

```bash
wkhtmltopdf report-redacted.html lynx-onepager.pdf
convert -density 150 lynx-onepager.pdf[0] -quality 90 lynx-gantt.png
```

legal-bot: Reminder: include attestation text and link to our DPA if requested. Also ensure no PII in the one-pager.
